edits.old: Lent $110 million for Phase 1A (Katse Dam), with South Africa standing surety, plus $8 million in concessional design loans. A $50 million loan for Phase 1B (Mohale) was before the Board in 1998.
edits.new: Lent $110 million for Phase 1A (Katse Dam), with South Africa standing surety, plus $8 million in concessional design loans. For Phase 1B (Mohale) the Bank approved loan IBRD-43390 of US$45 million on 4 June 1998; it became effective on 9 June 1999 and closed on 31 December 2006, with US$21.66 million disbursed, by the Bank's own completion report. The complainants' Inspection Panel request of 23 April 1998 described a $50 million Phase 1B loan as then before the Executive Directors.

lesotho-highlands.status: round 18: the $50m Phase 1B figure is the complainants' own from their Inspection Panel request, not the Bank's; the Bank approved US$45m. End year opened from 2006 to 2026, because the harm now runs to the October 2026 compensation order and unpaid arrears.
